notes: A PvPvE extraction shooter has no preset of its own, and Battle Royale is the only one built on the shape and the loot economy this needs, so I kept its name, its open-battlefield shape and its collectible-loot and building-interior rows, and dropped boundary-shrinking because a timed extraction is not a contracting play area. open-battlefield is right on the answers' own terms: one contiguous on-foot map of a couple of urban blocks joined to an industrial yard, dispersed points of interest rather than lanes, so no P4 for separate zones. Added capture-zone for the several fixed extraction points, which is also where the run ends, spawner-npc for the AI combatants, and settlement-density for the stated city blocks. Decided without a user: hidden loot spots across industrial and urban buildings mean players plainly go inside, so building-interior stays and the route is P3 - that is the one part of this build not on the proven pipeline yet, and it is flagged rather than quietly dropped; the pre-deploy loadout, kill feed, HUD and touch controls are interface rather than geometry, so they carry no layout option.
